No. 64.
Chinese Courts in the Settlement and French
Concession.

The following procedure will be adopted in future although
the instructions laid down herein are for the time being un-
official.

1. Jurisdiction. The provisional agreement of 1902 is con-
sidered cancelled by virtue of the rendition of the French
Mixed Court. Jurisdiction in criminal cases will lie with the
Court of the Settlement or Concession in which the crime has
been committed.

2. Warrants issued by the Chinese Courts of the French Con-
cession should be countersigned by the corresponding Chinese
Courts in the Settlement before execution and similarly warrant
issued by the Settlement Courts should be countersigned by the
corresponding Courts in the French Concession before execution.

3. With regard to the handing over of persons urgently wanted
by the Police the procedure followed hitherto will be continued,
i.e., persons wanted by one of the two Police Forces for offences
committed within the jurisdiction of that Force will be handed
over direct without being brought before the Court of the Settle-
ment in which they are arrested provided that the officer
authorising the handing over is satisfied that there is a bona
fide charge against the individual arrested.

In all cases of doubt, particularly those with a political
or quasi - political tinge, reference should be made to the
Divisional Officer concerned but this should not usually be
necessary.

(签名) (签名) R.M. Martin
Commissioner of Police.

第64号。
租界及法租界内的中国法院。

今后将采取以下程序，尽管此处规定的指示目前尚属非正式性质。

1. 管辖权。鉴于法国混合法庭的移交，1902年的临时协议被视为已取消。刑事案件的管辖权归属于犯罪发生地所在的租界或公董局辖区法院。

2. 由法租界中国法院签发的逮捕令，在执行前应由租界内相应的中国法院副署；同样，由租界法院签发的逮捕令，在执行前应由法租界内相应的法院副署。

3. 关于移交警方紧急通缉人员的事宜，将继续沿用迄今实行的程序，即：因在某一警力管辖范围内犯罪而被该警力通缉的人员，应直接移交，无需将其带至其被捕地所在租界的法庭受审，前提是授权移交的警官确信对被逮捕者提出的指控是真实有效的。

在所有存疑案件中，特别是那些带有政治或准政治色彩的案件，应向有关分区警官请示，但这通常并无必要。

(签名) (签名) R.M. Martin
警务处处长。

To: President Hsu Wet Tsung,
Chief Procurator Wong Tsung Nan,
Kiangsu 2nd Branch High Court.

It is hereby ordered that this Ministry is in
receipt of Despatch No. 993 from the Ministry of
Foreign Affairs, stating:

"The rules defining the respective juris-
dictions of the Former Mixed Courts in the Inter-
national Settlement and the French Concession in
Shanghai, which were agreed upon between the
Settlement and Concession Authorities in 1902
is a system anomalous to the general principles
of the law. Note 2 exchanged in connection with
the Agreement regarding the reorganization of the
Provisional Court signed in the 19th Year of the
Republic of China stipulates, 'It is understood
that the present practice regarding the respective
jurisdictions of the Chinese Court now functioning
in the International Settlement and the Court exist-
ing in the French Concession shall be followed,
pending a definite arrangement between the Chinese
Government and the authorities concerned.' Article 1
of the New French Mixed Court Rendition Agreement
states, 'all the rules and practices pertaining
thereto shall be abolished, together with the Mixed
Court.' Then the rules defining the respective juris-
dictions of the Mixed Courts in the International
Settlement and the French Concession are some of those
rules and practices which should be abolished.

"Note 2 of the Agreement of the 19th Year had
specific reference to the Court then functioning in
the International Settlement and the Court then exist-
ing in the French Concession. Since at present the
Court in the French Concession has been abolished,
the provision has automatically become inapplicable.

In the course of the negotiations concerning the
abolition of the French Mixed Court, it was many times
declared by the French Delegates that with the rendition
of the Court, these anomalous rules would automatically
become null and void. This declaration has been clearly
registered

兹命令本部收到外交部第993号公函，称：

“1902年租界与公董局当局之间商定的、界定上海公共租界和法租界前混合法庭各自管辖权的规则，是一种违背一般法律原则的特异制度。中华民国十九年签署的关于改组临时法院的协议所附换文第2号规定，‘谅解在目前中国政府与有关当局作出明确安排之前，将继续遵循目前关于在国际公共租界运作的中国法院与存在于法租界的法院各自管辖权的惯例。’新的《法国混合法庭移交协议》第一条规定，‘所有与此相关的规则和惯例应随混合法庭一并废除。’那么，界定国际公共租界和法租界混合法庭各自管辖权的规则，即属于应当废除的规则和惯例之列。

“民国十九年协议的换文第2号具体提及当时在国际公共租界运作的法院和当时存在于法租界的法院。鉴于目前法租界的法院已被废除，该条款已自动失效。

在关于废除法国混合法庭的谈判过程中，法国代表多次声明，随着法庭的移交，这些特异规则将自动无效。这一声明已明确记录

卷第二十三 列傳第十三

吳 延 陵 季 子

延陵季子者，吳王壽夢之少子也。壽夢有四子，長曰諸樊，次曰餘祭，次曰餘昧，次曰季札。季札賢，而壽夢欲立之，季札讓不可，於是乃立長子諸樊，攝行事當國。諸樊已除喪，讓位季札。季札謝曰：「曹宣公之卒也，諸侯與曹人不義曹君，將立子臧，子臧去之，以成曹君，君子曰『能守節矣』。君義嗣，誰敢干君！有國，非吾節也。札雖不材，願附於子臧之義。」吳人固立季札，季札棄其室而耕，乃舍之。諸樊十三年卒，弟餘祭立。十七年，季札使魯，觀周樂，見舞《韶箾》者，曰：「德至矣哉，大矣！如天之無不也，如地之無不載也。雖甚盛德，其蔑以加於此矣，觀止矣。若有他樂，吾不敢請已。」使齊，說晏平仲曰：「子速納邑與政，無邑無政，乃免於難。齊國之政將有所歸，未得所歸，難未息也。」晏子因陳桓子以納政與邑，是以免於欒高之難。使鄭，見子產如舊交，謂子產曰：「鄭之執政侈，難將至矣，政必及子。子為政，慎以禮。不然，鄭國將敗。」適衛，說蘧瑗、史狗、史鰌、公子、公孫發、公子朝曰：「衛多君子，未有患也。」自衛如晉，將宿於戚，聞鐘聲焉，曰：「異哉！吾聞之也，辯而不德，必加於戮。夫子獲罪於君以在此，懼猶不足，而又何樂？夫子之在戚也，君未葬而歌，吾不忍聞。」遂去之。晉人聞之，曰：「季札之來也，其知禮乎！」聘於晉，說趙文子、韓宣子、魏獻子曰：「晉國其萃於三族乎！」說叔向曰：「吾子勉之！君侈而多良，大夫皆富，政將在三家。吾子直，必思自免於難。」季札之初使，北過徐君。徐君好季札劍，口弗敢言。季札心知之，為使上國，未獻。還至徐，徐君已死，於是乃解其寶劍，繫之徐君冢樹而去。從者曰：「徐君已死，尚誰予乎？」季子曰：「不然。始吾心已許之，以死倍吾心哉！」二十九年，楚公子圍弒其君敖自立，為靈王。三十一年，吳王餘昧卒，欲授弟季札。季札讓，逃去。於是吳人曰：「先王有命，兄卒弟代立，必致季子。季子今逃位，則王餘昧後立。今卒，其子當代。」乃立王餘昧之子僚為王。四年，吳使季札聘於魯，請觀周樂。為歌《周南》、《召南》，曰：「美哉！始基之矣，猶未也，然勤而不怨矣。」為之歌《邶》、《鄘》、《衛》，曰：「美哉，淵乎！憂而不困者也。吾聞衛康叔、武公之德如是，是其《衛風》乎？」為之歌《王》，曰：「美哉！思而不懼，其周之東乎？」為之歌《鄭》，曰：「美哉！其細已甚，民弗堪也，是其先亡乎！」為之歌《齊》，曰：「美哉！泱泱乎大風也哉！表東海者，其大公乎！國未可量也。」為之歌《豳》，曰：「美哉！蕩乎！樂而不淫，其周公之東乎？」為之歌《秦》，曰：「此之謂夏聲。夫能夏則大，大之至也，其周之舊乎？」為之歌《魏》，曰：「美哉！渢渢乎！大而婉，險而易行，以德輔此，則明主也。」為之歌《唐》，曰：「思深哉！其有陶唐氏之遺民乎！不然，何其憂之遠也？非令德之後，誰能若是？」為之歌《陳》，曰：「國無主，其能久乎！」自《鄶》以下無譏焉。為之歌《小雅》，曰：「美哉！思而不貳，怨而不言，其周德之衰乎？猶有先王之遺民焉。」為之歌《大雅》，曰：「廣哉！熙熙乎！曲而有直體，其文王之德乎？」為之歌《頌》，曰：「至矣哉！直而不倨，曲而不屈，邇而不偪，遠而不攜，遷而不淫，復而不厭，哀而不愁，樂而不荒，用而不匱，廣而不宣，施而不費，取而不貪，處而不底，行而不流。五聲和，八風平，節有度，守有序，盛德之所同也。」見舞《象箾》、《南籥》者，曰：「美哉！猶有憾。」見舞《大武》者，曰：「美哉！周之盛也，其若此乎！」見舞《韶濩》者，曰：「聖人之弘也，而猶有德，聖人之難也。」見舞《大夏》者，曰：「美哉！勤而不德，非禹其誰能修之！」見舞《韶箾》者，曰：「德至矣哉，大矣！如天之無不幬也，如地之無不載也。雖甚盛德，其蔑以加於此矣，觀止矣。若有他樂，吾不敢請已。」出聘於齊，說晏平仲曰：「子速納邑與政。無邑無政，乃免於難。齊國之政將有所歸，未得所歸，難未息也。」晏子因陳桓子以納政與邑，是以免於欒高之難。聘於鄭，見子產，如舊交。謂子產曰：「鄭之執政侈，難將至矣，政必及子。子為政，慎以禮。不然，鄭國將敗。」適衛，說蘧瑗、史狗、史鰌、公子荊、公孫發、公子朝曰：「衛多君子，未有患也。」自衛如晉，將宿於戚，聞鐘聲焉，曰：「異哉！吾聞之也，辯而不德，必加於戮。夫子獲罪於君以在此，懼猶不足，而又何樂？夫子之在戚也，君未葬而歌，吾不忍聞。」遂去之。晉人聞之，曰：「季札之來也，其知禮乎！」聘於晉，說趙文子、韓宣子、魏獻子曰：「晉國其萃於三族乎！」說叔向曰：「吾子勉之！君侈而多良，大夫皆富，政將在三家。吾子直，必思自免於難。」季札之初使，北過徐君。徐君好季札劍，口弗敢言。季札心知之，為使上國，未獻。還至徐，徐君已死，於是乃解其寶劍，繫之徐君冢樹而去。從者曰：「徐君已死，尚誰予乎？」季子曰：「不然。始吾心已許之，豈以死倍吾心哉！」四十七年，楚公子圍弒其君郟敖自立，為靈王。五十一年，吳王餘昧卒，欲授弟季札。季札讓，逃去。於是吳人曰：「 Shanghai Morning Post Evening Edition (official organ of
Gen. Chiang Kai Shek) and other local newspapers:

SHANGHAI SPECIAL DISTRICT COURT RENDITION AGREEMENT
EXPIRES IN MARCH 1936

The rendition agreement of the Shanghai First
Special District Court was concluded on February 17, 1930
at Nanking. The agreement was put into force on
April 1 of the same year. According to Article 10 of
the agreement, the effective period of the agreement
is fixed at three years. The agreement expired at
the end of March 1933 when the period of the agreement
was extended for a further period of three years. The
second term of the agreement will expire at the end of
March 1936.

Chinese law circles in this locality are of
the opinion that the agreement of the Shanghai First
Special District Court should be revised when it expires
next year. The agreement had ten Articles with eight
Articles appended. There are many points in the agreement
that require revision, the most important points being
the question of the power of procurators and the problem
of the appointment of judicial police. Limited by the
agreement procurators of the Shanghai First Special
District Court have very little authority, matters of
public prosecution being handled by the Municipal Police.
Members of the judicial police are not directly appointed
by the President of the Court. The President should
appoint members of the judicial police, who have been
recommended by the Municipal Police.

Chinese connected with the local judicial
authorities hold the view that the organization of the
Courts in the International Settlement is different
from that of the Courts in other places in China.
Therefore, the rendition agreement of the Shanghai First
Special District Court must be revised upon expiry so
that its organization will parallel that of Courts in
other places in China. It is learned that the Ministry
of Justice is paying special attention to this matter
and will form a Judicial Rights Research Committee in
the near future. Among other things the Committee will
study the proposal for the abolition of Consular
Jurisdiction.

Recently certain foreign nationals in Shanghai
have proposed the formation of an International Court
of Arbitration to deal with the civil lawsuits of
foreigners. The Ministry of Justice is indignant over
this matter. At the present moment when the Chinese
Government is doing its utmost to abolish Consular
Jurisdiction, foreigners should not make an attempt to
interfere with Chinese judicial rights. It is learned
that the suggestion for the formation of an International
Court of Arbitration is the hope of only one or two
foreign nationals and the plan will not materialize.

（批：No. 7245）

《上海晨报》晚刊（蒋介石将军的官方喉舌）及其他本地报纸：

上海特区法院移交协议
将于1936年3月到期

上海第一特区法院的移交协议于1930年2月17日在南京签订。该协议于同年4月1日生效。根据协议第10条，协议有效期定为三年。该协议于1933年3月底期满，随后协议期限又延长了三年。协议的第二期将于1936年3月底到期。

本地法律界人士认为，上海第一特区法院的协议应在明年到期时进行修订。该协议共有十条正文，附有八条附件。协议中有许多要点需要修订，其中最重要的问题是检察官的权力问题以及司法警察的任命问题。受协议限制，上海第一特区法院的检察官权力很小，公诉事务由工部局警务处处理。司法警察成员并非由法院院长直接任命。院长应任命由工部局警务处推荐的司法警察成员。

与当地司法机构有关联的中国人认为，国际公共租界内法院的组织结构与中国其他地方的法院不同。因此，上海第一特区法院的移交协议必须在到期时进行修订，使其组织结构与中国其他地方的法院平行。据悉，司法部正特别关注此事，并将在近期成立一个司法权研究委员会。该委员会将研究包括废除领事裁判权提案在内的各项事宜。

最近，上海某些外籍人士提议成立一个国际仲裁法院，以处理外国人的民事诉讼。司法部对此事感到愤慨。在中国政府正竭尽全力废除领事裁判权的当下，外国人不应试图干涉中国的司法权利。据悉，成立国际仲裁法院的建议仅为一两名外籍人士的愿望，该计划不会实现。

（批：No. 7245）
（批：S）

China Evening News published the following telegram from Nanking
on May 10, 1935:-

RENDITION AGREEMENT OF SHANGHAI SPECIAL DISTRICT COURT
EXPIRES NEXT SPRING

The rendition agreement of the Shanghai Special
District Court (? the First Special District Court) will
expire in March 1936. The Chinese Government proposes
to issue in Autumn this year an announcement of the
abolition of Consular Jurisdiction. The judicial
authorities are studying this question. The Judicial
Rights Research Committee of the Ministry of Justice has
invited several persons to serve on this Committee. The
inauguration of the Committee will take place in a few days.
In connection with the proposal of the Shanghai
foreign residents to form an International Court of
Arbitration, a certain official of the Ministry of Foreign
Affairs states that these foreign residents are planning
to establish Consular Jurisdiction in another form in an
attempt to break China's judicial rights. The Government

Honorable Stirling Fessenden,
Director General and Chairman,
Shanghai Municipal Council.

Sir:

Suggestions re Changes in
the Rendition Agreement.

The Senior Consul has informed his Deputies that he will
be pleased to receive suggestions from them regarding proposed
changes in the Rendition Agreement, provided such suggestions
are made on or before March 31, 1929. In view of the fact that
the police are greatly concerned with the Shanghai Provisional
Court and the Rendition Agreement, I beg to submit herewith my
suggestions for proposed amendments to that document.

S Y N O P S I S

I. SOME DEFINITIONS.
II. JURISDICTION.
III. CONFLICT OF LAWS.
IV. DISPUTE CASES.
V. SUBPOENAS AND WARRANTS.
VI. APPEAL COURT.
VII. THE RIGHT OF THE KIANGSU GOVERNMENT
TO REVIEW CASES, AND ENFORCEMENT
OF THE DEATH PENALTY.
VIII. THE WOMENS' PRISON.
IX. EXTRADITION.
X. RATES AND TAXATION.
XI. MISCELLANEOUS.

I.

SOME DEFINITIONS.

There are a number of terms in the Rendition Agreement
which are not properly understood, and consequently have caused
serious dispute. I have accordingly defined some of these terms,
which are set forth hereunder:

(1) A "foreigner" is any person, corporation, partnership,
company, limited liability company, citizen or subject recog-
nized as such by a Government whose citizens or subjects have
extraterritorial rights in China by virtue of treaty between
such Government and China.

(2) A "Municipal Road" is any road, street, highway,
alley, path, premises, park or land owned or controlled or
operated or policed or maintained by the Council for the
Foreign Community of Shanghai, regardless of whether such
road as aforesaid is within or without the limits of the
Settlement.

1929年2月14日。

尊敬的费信惇先生，
总董兼主席，
上海工部局。

先生：

关于《移交协议》变更的建议。

首席领事已通知其副领事们，他乐意接收他们针对拟议的《移交协议》变更所提出的建议，前提是此类建议须在1929年3月31日或之前提出。鉴于警方与上海临时法院及《移交协议》关系重大，谨此提交我对该文件拟议修正案的建议。

摘 要

一、若干定义。
二、管辖权。
三、法律冲突。
四、争议案件。
五、传票与逮捕令。
六、上诉法院。
七、江苏省政府复审案件及执行死刑之权利。
八、女子监狱。
九、引渡。
十、费率与税收。
十一、杂项。

一、

若干定义。

《移交协议》中有若干术语未被正确理解，因而引发了严重争端。因此，我对其中部分术语进行了界定，列述如下：

(1) “外国人”系指任何个人、法人、合伙组织、公司、有限责任公司、公民或臣民，且因其所属政府与中国之间的条约而在中国享有治外法权者，经该政府承认为其公民或臣民。

(2) “工部局道路”系指由上海外人社区工部局拥有、控制、运营、 policing（警务管辖）或维护的任何道路、街道、公路、巷弄、小径、处所、公园或土地，无论上述道路是否位于租界界限之内。

（批注：见 CR. C.1201）

page_data.en:
2.
(3) A "Deputy" is anyone deputized or authorized by the
Senior Consul of the Consular Body at Shanghai, China, to
act as his representative in the Shanghai Provisional Court.
(4) A "Consular Representative" is a representative of
a nation having extraterritorial rights in China and who
sits in the Provisional Court in mixed cases as the repre-
sentative of the Government of the complainant or plaintiff.
(5) The "Settlement" is the International Settlement
of Shanghai, China, as specified in Article I of the Land
Regulations or any subsequent treaty or regulation which
may modify such area.
(6) A "Mixed Case" is a case in which the plaintiff or
complainant is a foreigner, or in which some foreigner is
financially interested.
(7) The "Court" means the Chinese Judge and the Deputy.
The above suggested definitions are self-explanatory, and
give you an idea of some of the misunderstandings which have ari-
sen by virtue of failure of proper definitions of terms.
II.
JURISDICTION.
Article 1, Subdivision I of the Rendition Agreement, in the
second sentence thereof, provides as follows:
". . . With the exception of cases which in accordance
with the treaties involve the right of Consular jurisdic-
tion, all civil and criminal cases in the Settlement shall
be dealt with by the said Provisional Court."
This sentence was further amplified by the Consular Body's
letter of December 31, 1926, which among other things, provides:
"It is understood that the competence of the Court as
described in Article I (1) includes also
(a) Mixed Criminal cases arising on foreign vessels
within Harbour limits.
(b) Mixed Criminal cases arising on foreign property,
including municipal roads outside the limits of the Settle-
ment but within the districts of Shanghai and Paoshan,
provided always that this understanding shall not operate
to preclude further negotiations regarding the status of
such roads.
(c) Mixed Civil cases arising in the surrounding areas
within the districts of Shanghai and Paoshan.
"It is further understood that the respective jurisdic-
tions of the Mixed Courts of the French and International
Settlements remain as defined in the Provisional Agreement
of June 28, 1902."
These clauses have given rise to serious disputes regarding
jurisdiction -- the Foreigners on the one hand striving to main-
tain the same jurisdiction as the International Mixed exercises,
and the Chinese on the other hand, to break it down as much as
possible. I would therefore suggest that in lieu of the above
page_data.zh:

(3) “副领事”（Deputy）系指由中国上海领事团首席领事委派或授权，在上海临时法院作为其代表行事之人。
(4) “领事代表”系指在华享有治外法权国家的代表，其在混合案件中出席临时法院，作为控告人或原告所属政府的代表。
(5) “租界”系指中国上海公共租界，如《土地章程》第一条所规定，或任何可能修改该区域的后续条约或规章所规定者。
(6) “混合案件”系指原告或控告人为外国人，或有外国人涉及财务利益的案件。
(7) “法院”系指中国法官与副领事。
上述建议的定义不言自明，并使阁下了解因术语定义不当而产生的一些误解。

二、
管辖权。

《移交协议》第一条第一款第二句规定如下：
“……除根据条约涉及领事裁判权的案件外，租界内所有民事和刑事案件均应由上述临时法院处理。”

领事团在1926年12月31日的信函中对此句作了进一步阐释，其中规定：
“兹理解，第一条(1)所述法院之权限亦包括：
(a) 在港口界限内的外国船只上发生的混合刑事案件。
(b) 在外国财产上发生的混合刑事案件，包括位于租界界限之外但位于上海和宝山区域内的工部局道路，惟此理解不得妨碍就此类道路地位进行进一步谈判。
(c) 在上海和宝山区域内周边地区发生的混合民事案件。
“另理解，法租界与公共租界混合法庭各自的管辖权仍按1902年6月28日《临时协议》之规定执行。”

这些条款引发了关于管辖权的严重争端——一方面，外国人竭力维持与国际混合法庭行使相同的管辖权；另一方面，中国人则尽可能试图打破这种管辖权。因此，我建议以以下内容取代上述

page_data.en:
3.
quoted clauses, the following be substituted:
"Said Court shall have sole and exclusive jurisdiction (with the exception of cases which, in accordance with the treaties involve the right of jurisdiction), to try finally determine and adjudicate the following:
(1) All criminal cases in which the offence is committed,
(a) Within the limits of the Settlement;
(b) On a municipal road;
(c) On premises bordering or or having ingress and egress to and from any municipal road.
(2) All criminal cases in which the complainant is a Foreigner,
(a) Where the offence is committed on a vessel within the harbor limits of Shanghai, China;
(b) Where the offence is committed within the districts of Shanghai and Paoshan.
(3) All criminal cases in which the offence is committed on property within the districts of Shanghai and Paoshan and owned by a Foreigner.
(4) All civil cases arising within the limits of the International Settlement of Shanghai, China, or on municipal roads.
(5) All civil cases arising within the districts of Shanghai and Paoshan, in which the plaintiff is a Foreigner.
"The respective jurisdictions of the Mixed Courts of the International Settlement shall remain as defined in the Provisional Agreement of June 28, 1908."
I would call your attention to the following in the Consular Body's letter above referred to:
Article 1, Subsection b provides for jurisdiction on offences committed on a municipal road. "Municipal Road" has been defined on page 3, paragraph 2 hereof. The policy of the Chinese is to limit the jurisdiction of the present Provisional Court to crimes that actually happened on a municipal road, whereas under the Mixed Court régime, the words "Municipal Road" were construed as above defined.
Article 1, Subsection c also provides for jurisdiction on premises bordering on and having ingress and egress to and from any municipal road. The Provisional Court has refused to take jurisdiction in such cases, although jurisdiction was constantly
page_data.zh:
3.
引用的条款：
“该法院拥有唯一且排他的管辖权（除根据条约涉及司法管辖权的案件外），对以下案件进行最终审理、裁定和判决：
(1) 所有犯罪行为发生在以下地点的刑事案件：
(a) 租界界限内；
(b) 工部局道路上；
(c) 毗邻工部局道路或与之有进出通道的处所。
(2) 所有控告人为外国人的刑事案件：
(a) 犯罪行为发生在中国上海港口界限内的船只上；
(b) 犯罪行为发生在上海和宝山区域内。
(3) 所有犯罪行为发生在上海和宝山区域内且为外国人所有的财产上的刑事案件。
(4) 所有发生在中国上海公共租界界限内或工部局道路上的民事案件。
(5) 所有发生在上海和宝山区域内且原告为外国人的民事案件。
“公共租界混合法庭各自的管辖权仍按1908年6月28日《临时协议》之规定执行。”

提请阁下注意上述提及的领事团信函中的以下内容：
第一条b款规定了对在工部局道路上犯罪行为的管辖权。“工部局道路”已在本文第3页第2段中定义。中方的政策是将现任临时法院的管辖权限制在实际发生在工部局道路上的犯罪，而在混合法庭体制下，“工部局道路”一词按上述定义解释。
第一条c款还规定了对毗邻工部局道路并与其有进出通道的处所的管辖权。尽管混合法庭一直对此类案件行使管辖权，但临时法院拒绝受理此类案件。上述关于管辖权的条款将消除目前的争端。

page_data.en:
4.
taken over such cases by the Mixed Court. The above clause re
jurisdiction would do away with the present dispute.

III.
CONFLICT OF LAWS

Article 1, Subsection 2 of the Rendition Agreement provides
that the Chinese laws shall apply "due account being taken of
the terms of the present agreement and all such established
rules of procedure as shall be hereafter agreed upon."

The last section has given rise to serious dispute, the
Chinese contending that the Chinese law takes precedence over
the Rendition Agreement, and the Mixed Court Rules of Procedure.
Such was not the intention. I would therefore suggest that the
following be inserted in lieu thereof:

"Provided however, such laws do not conflict with
this Rendition Agreement or the Rules of Procedure
formerly applicable in the International Mixed Court.
In the event such laws or ordinances conflict with this
Agreement or with said International Mixed Court Rules
of Procedure, the terms of this Agreement and of said
International Mixed Court Rules of Procedure shall
apply in preference to such laws."

VI.
DEPUTY CASES

Article 1, Subsection III of the Rendition Agreement
provides as follows:

"(iii) In criminal cases which directly affect
the peace and order of the International Settlement,
including contraventions of the Land Regulations and
Bye-Laws of the International Settlement, and in all
criminal cases in which the accused is in the employ
of a Foreigner having extraterritorial rights, the
Senior Consul may appoint a Deputy to sit with the
Judge to watch the proceedings. The concurrence of
the Deputy shall not be necessary for the validity of
the judgment, though he shall have the right to record
his objections; he shall not, however, put any ques-
tion to the witnesses or prisoners without the consent
of the Judge."

The Chinese Authorities, together with the Consular Body,
have wrongly construed the words "criminal cases which directly
affect the peace and order of the International Settlement."
They have attempted to define what cases do directly affect the
peace and order of the International Settlement, and what
offences do not. They have drawn up what is known as a
page_data.zh:
4.

三、
法律冲突

《移交协议》第一条第二款规定，中国法律应予适用，“同时适当考虑本协议条款及此后商定的所有既定程序规则”。

最后一部分引发了严重争端，中方主张中国法律优先于《移交协议》和混合法庭程序规则。这并非本意。因此，我建议插入以下内容以取代之：

“但前提是该等法律不与本《移交协议》或原国际混合法庭适用的程序规则相冲突。若该等法律或法令与本《协议》或上述国际混合法庭程序规则相冲突，则应优先适用本《协议》及上述国际混合法庭程序规则的条款。”

六、
副领事参与案件

《移交协议》第一条第三款规定如下：

“(iii) 在直接影响公共租界和平与秩序的刑事案件中，包括违反公共租界《土地章程》及附例的行为，以及在所有被告受雇于享有治外法权的外国人的刑事案件中，首席领事可指派一名副领事与法官同席以监督诉讼程序。判决的有效性无需副领事的同意，但他有权记录其异议；然而，未经法官同意，他不得向证人或囚犯提出任何问题。”

中国当局连同领事团错误地解释了“直接影响公共租界和平与秩序的刑事案件”一词。他们试图界定哪些案件直接影响公共租界的和平与秩序，哪些罪行则不然。他们制定了一份所谓的

page_data.en:
5.
classification of offences. This classification and the above
quoted clauses in the Renition Agreement has been a constant
source of dispute between the Judges and the Deputies. In my
letter of September 16, 1928, addressed to the Commissioner of
Police, copy of which you have, I defined the meaning of the
words "in criminal cases which directly affect the peace and
order of the Settlement", and defined such terms "to be all
cases in which the criminal law is contravened."

There can be no question that the presence of the Deputy
prevents the Chinese Judges from committing egregious errors.
Non-Deputy cases are marked by the errors and unfairness of the
Judge. In the French Mixed Court, the Deputy or Assessor not
only sits in all criminal cases, but is a member of the Court,
together with the Judge. I therefore suggest that Article 1,
Subsection III be entirely deleted and the following inserted
in its place:

"In all criminal cases prosecuted by the municipal
police or in which the summons, warrant or order is
served by the municipal police, the Senior Consul may
appoint a Deputy to sit with the Judge to watch the
proceedings. The concurrence of the Deputy shall be
necessary for the validity of the judgment; he may put
any questions to the witnesses or prisoners without the
consent of the Judge. In the event the Deputy and the
Judge fail to agree on a judgment within two weeks
after date of trial, said case shall be referred to
another Judge and Deputy for retrial. In the event the
second Judge and Deputy fail to agree within two weeks
after conclusion of the trial, the case shall be re-
ferred to the Appeal Court for final determination."

V.

SUMMONSES AND WARRANTS

Article 1, Subsection IV provides:

"All summonses, warrants, and orders of the Court
shall be valid after they have been signed by a Judge."

The Chinese Judges hold that the only thing they have to
do-is to issue a warrant is to have it filled in and signed.
According to their idea, it is not necessary that it be proved
that it is probable that an offence has been committed. Warrants
have been issued in many cases by order of the Nanking Authori-
ties without reference to the justice or rights of the case.
The most glaring example of this is what is known as the Sheng
page_data.zh:
5.
罪行分类表。这一分类以及《移交协议》中上述引用的条款一直是法官与副领事之间争端的根源。在我于1928年9月16日致警务处处长的信中（阁下持有副本），我定义了“在直接影响租界和平与秩序的刑事案件中”一词的含义，并将此类术语定义为“所有违反刑法的案件”。

毫无疑问，副领事的在场防止了中国法官犯下严重错误。无副领事参与的案件以法官的错误和不公为特征。在法租界混合法庭，副领事或陪审员不仅出席所有刑事案件，而且与法官共同组成法庭成员。因此，我建议完全删除第一条第三款，并代之以以下内容：

“在所有由工部局警察起诉或由工部局警察送达传票、逮捕令或命令的刑事案件中，首席领事可指派一名副领事与法官同席以监督诉讼程序。判决的有效性须有副领事的同意；他可在未经法官同意的情况下向证人或囚犯提出任何问题。若副领事与法官在庭审日期后两周内未能就判决达成一致，该案应移交另一名法官和副领事重审。若第二名法官和副领事在庭审结束后两周内仍未能达成一致，该案应移交上诉法院作最终裁定。”

五、

传票与逮捕令

第一条第四款规定：

“法院的所有传票、逮捕令和命令经法官签署后即为有效。”

中国法官认为，签发逮捕令只需填写并签署即可。按照他们的想法，没有必要证明很可能已发生犯罪行为。在许多情况下，南京当局下令签发逮捕令，而不顾及案件的公正性或权利。其中最显著的例子是所谓的盛

page_data.en:
6.
Kung Pao Estate. I would, therefore, suggest that the above
quoted clause be deleted and the following inserted:
"Summonses, warrants and orders of the Court shall
be valid only after they have been signed by a Judge
and the Senior Consul or his Deputy."
This procedure was followed in the International Mixed
Court. In that Court, a warrant had to be applied for and a
prima facie case proved, and in addition, the warrant had to be
countersigned by the Senior Consul or his Deputy.
VI.
APPEAL COURT
Article 1, Subdivision VI of the Rendition Agreement pro-
vides:
"(vi) A Court of Appeal shall be established in
connexion with the Provisional Court to deal with
criminal cases which directly affect the peace and
order of the Settlement and with mixed criminal cases.
The President of the Provisional Court shall act con-
currently as President of the Court of Appeal. No
appeal shall be allowed in cases in which the penalty
is below the maximum imprisonment of the fifth degree,
nor in cases under the Land Regulations and Bye-laws
of the International Settlement."
The President of the Provisional Court has never taken his
seat as Judge of the Criminal Appeal Court. The President seems
to be an administrative officer rather than a Judge. I can
see no reason why cases arising under the Land Regulations and
Bye-Laws should be discriminated against with reference to
appeals. Some of the cases arising under the Land Regulations
and Bye-Laws are of vast importance, and both defendants and
the prosecution should have the right of appeal. I would there-
fore suggest that the last two sentences of the above quoted
clause be eliminated and that there be inserted in their places
the following:
"The decisions of said Court shall be final and
binding, and no further appeal shall be allowed."
page_data.zh:
6.
工部局地产。因此，我建议删除上述引用的条款，并插入以下内容：
“法院的传票、逮捕令和命令仅在由法官及首席领事或其副手签署后方为有效。”
国际混合法庭曾遵循此程序。在该法庭，申请逮捕令需证明存在初步证据（prima facie case），此外，逮捕令还需由首席领事或其副手会签。

VI.
上诉法院

《移交协议》第一条第六款规定：
“(vi) 应设立一所与临时法院相关联的上诉法院，以审理直接影响租界治安秩序的刑事案件以及混合刑事案件。临时法院院长应兼任上诉法院院长。凡刑罚低于第五等最高监禁刑期的案件，以及涉及国际租界《土地章程》和附则的案件，不得上诉。”

临时法院院长从未以刑事上诉法院法官的身份开庭审案。该院长似乎是一名行政官员，而非司法官。我看不出有何理由在上诉权方面对因违反《土地章程》和附则而产生的案件加以歧视。某些因违反《土地章程》和附则而产生的案件至关重要，被告方和检控方均应享有上诉权。因此，我建议删除上述引用条款的最后两句，并代之以以下内容：
“该法院之判决应为终局且具有约束力，不得再行上诉。”

page_data.en:
7.
VII.
THE RIGHT OF THE KIANGSU GOVERNMENT
TO REVIEW CASES, AND ENFORCEMENT
OF THE DEATH PENALTY.

Article 2 of the Rendition Agreement provides as follows:

"In cases involving imprisonment for ten years or more
and in cases involving the death penalty, the Provisional
Court shall report the same to the Kiangsu Provincial
Government for approval. In cases in which the Provincial
Government refuses its approval, the Provincial Govern-
ment shall give its reasons and order the Provisional
Court to rehear the case and again submit the judgment
to the Provincial Government. All criminal cases in which
the infliction of the death penalty has been approved
shall be remitted to the Chinese Authorities outside the
Settlement for the execution of such penalty. Inquests
and autopsies (Chien Yen) in the Settlement shall be held
jointly by the Judges and the Provisional Court and the
Deputies appointed by the Senior Consul."

The first two sentences of this article have caused the
Shanghai Municipal Police more trouble and expense than any other
article in the whole agreement. The intention of the article un-
doubtedly was to permit the Kiangsu Provincial Government to
review the case on the record. A number of unscrupulous Chinese
lawyers have taken advantage of the fact that the record goes to
the Kiangsu Provincial Government and appeared in Nanking, either
in person or by the filing of a petition, and requested that a
retrial be ordered. A most glaring example of this is the recent
case of Liu Ah Ker. In that case the first defendant was sen-
tenced to life imprisonment and the last two defendants to death.
Instead of appealing to the Appeal Court, they filed a petition
with the Kiangsu Provincial Government, which ordered a retrial.
After a retrial, the lower Court reduced the first defendant's
sentence to ten years and the last two defendants to four years
and six months. The police appealed from this decision, the
result of which was the reaffirmance of a decision by the lower
Court rendered at the first and original trial. The lawyers for
the defendant were severely reprimanded by the Court for their
conduct.

In most of these rehearing cases, the police are put at a
very distinct disadvantage. By the time the rehearing is ordered,
page_data.zh:
7.
VII.
江苏省政府复核案件及执行死刑之权利

《移交协议》第二条规定如下：

“凡涉及十年或十年以上监禁的案件及涉及死刑的案件，临时法院应将此类案件呈报江苏省政府核准。若省政府拒绝核准，应说明理由，并命令临时法院重审该案，再次将判决呈报省政府。所有经核准执行死刑的刑事案件，应移送租界外的中国当局执行该刑罚。租界内的验尸和尸检（Chien Yen）应由临时法院法官及首席领事委派的副手共同进行。”

本条前两句给上海公共租界警务处带来的麻烦和费用，超过整个协议中的任何其他条款。该条款的意图无疑是允许江苏省政府根据案卷记录复核案件。一些无良中国律师利用案卷送交江苏省政府这一事实，亲自或通过提交请愿书的方式在南京出面，请求下令重审。最近的刘阿格（Liu Ah Ker，音译）案便是最明显的例子。在该案中，第一被告被判处无期徒刑，最后两名被告被判处死刑。他们未向上诉法院提起上诉，而是向江苏省政府提交请愿书，省政府遂下令重审。重审后，初审法院将第一被告的刑期减为十年，将最后两名被告的刑期减为四年六个月。警方对该判决提出上诉，结果维持了初审法院在第一次原始审判中作出的判决。被告律师因其行为受到法庭的严厉训诫。

在大多数这类重审案件中，警方处于非常不利的地位。等到下令重审时，

page_data.en:
8.
the witnesses have dispersed and are difficult to locate, which
often results in a miscarriage of justice. It seems to me, there-
fore, that some substitute for the first two sentences of Article
2 should be agreed upon. Either the decision of the Appeal Court
should be final and binding, or in lieu of sending the case to
the Kiangsu Provincial Government for approval, a sort of Super-
Appeal Court should be provided for, in which both the police and
the accused may appear and present their contentions. Such appeal
should be confined to the record, and no new evidence should be
permitted.

The police have had a great deal of trouble in delays and
procrastination in the execution of the death sentences. A time
limit should be set within which the death penalty should be
inflicted. I would therefore suggest that the last two sentences
of the above clause be changed to read as follows:

"In all criminal cases wherein the death penalty is
inflicted, said sentences shall be executed by the
Chinese Authorities outside the Settlement within two
weeks after the judgment becomes final. Inquests and
autopsies (Chien Yen) in the Settlement shall be held
jointly by the Judges of the Provisional Court and the
Deputies appointed by the Senior Consul."

VIII.

THE WOMEN'S PRISON

Article 3 of the Rendition Agreement provides:

"The prisons attached to the Provisional Court, with
the exception of the House of Detention for civil cases
and the Women's Prison which are to be separately pro-
vided for, shall be under the charge of the Municipal
Police. . ."

Up to the present writing, the Women's Prison has never been
separately provided for. I can see no reason why any distinction
should be made between women and men. The women at the present
time are incarcerated in the Mixed Court Women's Gaol, which,
according to all reports, is a filthy hole, insanitary, full of
vermin and unfit for human habitation. Some provision should be
made whereby the Women's Gaol will come under the jurisdiction
of the Shanghai Municipal Police.
page_data.zh:
8.
证人已四散，难以寻找，这往往导致司法不公。因此，我认为应就替代第二条前两句的内容达成协议。要么上诉法院的判决为终局且具有约束力，要么作为将案件送交江苏省政府核准的替代方案，设立某种超级上诉法院，警方和被告均可出庭陈述主张。此类上诉应仅限于案卷记录，不得采纳新证据。

警方在执行死刑判决的延误和拖延方面遇到了极大困难。应设定执行死刑的时限。因此，我建议将上述条款的最后两句修改如下：

“在所有判处死刑的刑事案件中，该判决应在成为终局判决后的两周内，由租界外的中国当局执行。租界内的验尸和尸检（Chien Yen）应由临时法院法官及首席领事委派的副手共同进行。”

VIII.

女子监狱

《移交协议》第三条规定：

“附属於临时法院的监狱，除民事拘留所和女子监狱将另行安排外，均由工部局警务处管辖……”

截至本文撰写之时，女子监狱从未得到另行安排。我看不出有任何理由在女性和男性之间作出区分。目前女性被关押在混合法庭女子监狱，据各方报告，那是一个肮脏不堪、卫生恶劣、充满害虫且不宜人类居住的地方。应采取某些措施，使女子监狱归入上海公共租界警务处的管辖范围。

page_data.en:
9.
IX.
EXTRADITION
The police earnestly desire that some arrangement should be
made with the Chinese Authorities relative to extradition cases.
The Consular Body requires that the usual prima facie case be proved
before extradition is allowed. The Chinese police in native terri-
tory are only too willing to cooperate with the International
Settlement police, but expect a return of courtesies, which the
International police are not always able to give. The officers of
the police force in charge of extradition matters feel that the
Commissioner of Police or his Deputy should be empowered to hand
over to the Chinese Authorities, without order of Court, persons
wanted by them, and who have no permanent employment or permanent
residence within the Settlement.
While I quite see the police point of view in desiring to co-
operate as far as possible with the Chinese Authorities, yet I
cannot see my way clear to agree with the suggestion that the
Commissioner of Police or his Deputy should have authority to
extradite persons without order of Court. Such an arrangement
would give the Commissioner of Police judicial powers which it was
never contemplated he should have. My views on this subject are
set forth in detail in my letter of November 1, 1928, addressed to
Mr. S. L. Burdett, representing the Senior Consul's Deputies. In
that letter, I set forth the necessity of having all persons de-
sired by the Chinese Authorities brought before the Provisional
Court for hearing. I further set forth the following conclusions
relative to Extradition cases:
(1) A crime committed in the International Settlement is
triable only in the Provisional Court unless the
complainant is a French citizen.
(2) A bona fide resident of the Settlement who commits
a crime in Chinese territory can only be extradited
(to an Extra-Settlement Court for trial) if a strong
prima facie case is made out against him.
(3) A non-resident of the Settlement who commits a crime
in Chinese territory and flees to the Settlement for
protection may be extradited upon the production of
a proper despatch warrant.
page_data.zh:
9.
IX.
引渡

警方迫切希望与中国当局就引渡案件达成某种安排。领事团要求在允许引渡前必须证明存在通常的初步证据（prima facie case）。华界的中国警察非常愿意与国际租界警方合作，但期望得到礼尚往来的回报，而国际警方并不总能给予这种回报。负责引渡事务的警务人员认为，应授权警务处长或其副手，无需法院命令，即可将被中国当局通缉且在租界内无固定职业或固定住所的人员移交给中国当局。

虽然我完全理解警方希望尽可能与中国当局合作的立场，但我无法同意警务处长或其副手有权在没有法院命令的情况下引渡人员的建议。此种安排将赋予警务处长司法权力，而这绝非初衷。我在1928年11月1日致代表首席领事副手的S. L. Burdett先生的信中详细阐述了我对此事的看法。在该信中，我阐述了将所有被中国当局要求的人员带至临时法院听审的必要性。我还进一步提出了关于引渡案件的以下结论：
(1) 在国际租界内犯下的罪行，除非原告为法国公民，否则仅可在临时法院受审。
(2) 在中国领土犯罪并在租界有正当居留身份的居民，只有在对其提出强有力的初步证据（prima facie case）时，方可被引渡（至租界外法院受审）。
(3) 非租界居民在中国领土犯罪并逃至租界寻求庇护者，凭适当的遣送逮捕令即可被引渡。

page_data.en:
10.
Experience has demonstrated to me that when the Chinese
Authorities desire to extradite a bona fide and well-known resi-
dent of the Settlement, there is generally some ulterior motive,--
for example, the pawn-shop or goldsmith case that created so much
discussion, or the case in which it was sought to extradite a man
and his wife for harboring their daughter who had run away from
her husband. In cases of this kind, it is essential that a strong
prima face case be made out and that if ulterior motives exist,
same should be publicly exposed. On the other hand, however,
the great majority of extradition cases are ones in which persons
have committed crimes in the Interior and fled to Shanghai for
sanctuary. In cases of this kind, the mere production of a des-
patch warrant should be quite sufficient proof that a crime has
been committed. The Settlement Authorities do not desire in any
way whatever to protect criminals of any sort, especially those
who flee to the Settlement for protection. It seems to me that
the putting into force of the three rules as above mentioned would
enable the municipal police to cooperate as fully as possible with
the Chinese Authorities. It must be borne in mind that the
Chinese Authorities frequently ask for the extradition of persons
which according to law should not be extradited, and if extradi-
tion is refused, a charge of refusal to cooperate is made. This
has been clearly demonstrated in several recent Communist cases
in which the Chinese Authorities have endeavoured to have persons
extradited who committed crimes in the Settlement.
I suggest, therefore, that an agreement along the lines of
the three principles above mentioned should be made with the
Chinese Authorities.

X.
RATES AND TAXES
It is getting more and more difficult for the Council to
collect rates and taxes due and owing by persons subject to the
Provisional Court. In most every country of the world, a failure
to pay taxes will result in summary proceedings and the seizure
page_data.zh:
10.
经验向我表明，当中国当局希望引渡一名在租界有正当身份且知名的居民时，通常别有用心——例如引起诸多议论的当铺或金匠案，或者试图引渡一对夫妇的案件，理由是他们窝藏了离家出走的女儿。在此类案件中，必须提出强有力的初步证据（prima face case），如果存在别有用心，应予以公开揭露。另一方面，绝大多数引渡案件是人员在内地犯罪后逃至上海寻求庇护的情况。在此类案件中，仅出示遣送逮捕令就足以证明罪行已发生。租界当局绝不希望以任何方式保护任何类型的罪犯，尤其是那些逃至租界寻求庇护的人。我认为，实施上述三条规则将使市政警方能够尽可能充分地与中国当局合作。必须牢记，中国当局经常要求引渡依法不应被引渡的人员，如果拒绝引渡，就会被指责为不合作。这在最近的几起共产党案件中已得到清楚证明，中国当局试图引渡在租界内犯罪的人员。

因此，我建议与中国当局按照上述三项原则的精神达成协议。

X.
捐税

工部局越来越难以向受临时法院管辖的人员收取到期和欠缴的捐税。在世界上大多数国家，欠税会导致简易程序和财产扣押。

page_data.en:
11.
of property. Some arrangement should be made with the Chinese
Authorities relative to rate cases. The Council should be able
to file suit and obtain a hearing within seven days from date of
receipt of summons by the defendant. Upon judgment being ren-
dered, the defendant's property should immediately be sealed up
and if judgment is not paid within fourteen days, the property
should be sold at public auction.

XI.
MISCELLANEOUS
There are many other miscellaneous matters which will bear
adjustment: (1) The Mixed Court Rules of Procedure should be re-
vised and improved; (2) the Foreign Staff in the Provisional Court
should be maintained; (3) a list of offences which may be punished
by Expulsion should be agreed upon; (4) some method of disciplining
Chinese lawyers should be provided for; (5) suitable offices and
waiting rooms should be provided for the Deputies, Police wit-
nesses, Court Inspectors, Judicial Police, Prosecuting Solicitors
and for the general public; (6) the question of the official
language to be used in the Court should be taken up and adjusted;
(7) the Execution Court should be abolished; (8) a time limit
should be set wherein cases should be heard after filing; (9) the
Police should be permitted to grant bail in all minor cases with-
out reference to the Court.

R. T. Bryan, Jr.
Prosecuting Solicitor.
page_data.zh:
11.
应与中国当局就捐税案件达成某种安排。工部局应能够提起诉讼，并在被告收到传票之日起七天内获得听审机会。判决作出后，应立即查封被告财产；如果在十四天内未支付判决款项，应将财产公开拍卖。

XI.
其他事项

还有许多其他杂项事宜需要调整：(1) 应修订和改进混合法庭诉讼规则；(2) 应保留临时法院的外籍职员；(3) 应商定一份可处以驱逐出境惩罚的罪行清单；(4) 应制定惩戒中国律师的方法；(5) 应为副手、警方证人、法庭视察员、司法警察、检控律师及公众提供合适的办公室和候审室；(6) 应处理并调整法庭使用的官方语言问题；(7) 应废除执行法庭；(8) 应设定立案后审理案件的时限；(9) 应允许警方在所有轻微案件中准予保释，无需请示法院。

R. T. Bryan, Jr.
检控律师

October 10, 1929
THE CHINA CRITIC
80

The Rendition Agreement

Nothing is more illustrative of the impudence of the foreign “diehards” than their vicious campaign against the Shanghai Provisional Court. Let it not be imagined that their antagonism is in any way inspired by the interests for peace and justice, but much of the bitter tirades against the present court is aimed at prolonging the life of the Rendition Agreement,—the very basis upon which the present situation is founded but under which the Consular and Settlement authorities still maintain an obnoxious control over the institution.

The Rendition Agreement negotiated between the Consular authorities and the defunct militarist administration of Kiangsu Province became operative on January 1, 1927 and is to be effective for three years. As it has but three more months to run, the Chinese are determined to replace the Provisional Court with a purely Chinese institution. This will completely deprive the Consular and Municipal authorities of what is left of a power they once usurped; hence the bitter campaign against the Provisional Court conducted in the hope of convincing the Powers that the termination of the Rendition Agreement would usher in even worse conditions.

Without going back to the old Mixed Court days when the foreign assessors made themselves into virtual judges of the court, let us point the defects of this Rendition Agreement. Instead of improving the situation, it is full of precisely the same defects which the Chinese complained of before.

First and foremost among the shortcomings of the agreement is undoubtedly the continual presence of the foreign deputies and their right to watch proceedings and record objections. Judging from the numerous foolish protests they have made and which have from time to time been pointed out in the columns of The Critic, there is apparently a proclivity among the foreign deputies to regain the power that the assessors of the defunct Mixed Court once wielded. The petty-mindedness of the deputies, their lack of sufficient legal training and their insolent attitude of superiority over the Chinese judges have, besides being inimical to the dignity of China, rendered smooth running of the court impossible.

The second defect must be ascribed to the role being played by the Municipal Police in its control over the court. The Rendition Agreement confers vast powers on the Municipal Police and places under its control the premises of the court as well as all the prisons attached to the court with the exception of the House of Detention for civil cases and the Women’s Prison. All summonses, warrants and orders issued by the court are also to be executed by the Judicial Police which are detailed from the Municipal Police. Cases have occurred where the police refused to carry out the order of the court. By virtue of the ample powers granted the police under the Rendition Agreement the court is to a large extent under the mercy of the police, and the whole machinery may cease functioning at any moment whenever the police withdraw assistance and co-operation. Even when they do condescend to co-operate with the court, their co-operation is never sincere and is subject to the dictates of the Consular Body and the Municipal Council.

Thirdly, the appointment of the Foreign Chief Clerk of the court has never been found satisfactory. Under the present agreement he is to be entrusted with the financial affairs and the general administration of the court. He is recommended by the Consular Body and his appointment is forced upon the Kiangsu Provincial Government. While he is subject to the supervision and orders of the court, the latter cannot establish any effective control over him and cannot remove him without the consent of the Consular Body. He wields great powers and has the full support of the Consular and Municipal authorities. It is abnormal that a foreigner should control the financial resources of a Chinese institution—a situation that the Chinese are bound to remove.

The above-mentioned are a few glaring defects of the Rendition Agreement, which, let it be borne in mind, has never been recognized by the National Government. In short, the shortcomings of the deputy system, the control of the Municipal Police over the court, the post of a Foreign Chief Clerk and the interference of the Consular

Body seriously condition the status of the Provisional Court that it is hardly a part of the Chinese judicial system. As this court has only jurisdiction among Chinese citizens and nationals of countries without extraterritorial rights, it has every right to complete independence from foreign influence and interference. Certainly present-day China cannot tolerate foreign interference with the exercise of her jurisdiction over Chinese citizens.

《中国评论周报》
第80页

收回会审公廨协定

外国“顽固派”的厚颜无耻，莫过于他们对上海临时法院发起的恶毒攻击。切勿以为他们的敌对态度是出于对和平与正义的任何关切；相反，针对当前法院的许多激烈抨击，旨在延长《收回会审公廨协定》的寿命——该协定虽是当前局势的基础，但在此之下，领事团和租界当局仍对该机构维持着令人厌恶的控制。

由领事当局与已不复存在的江苏省军阀政府谈判达成的《收回会审公廨协定》于1927年1月1日生效，有效期为三年。由于仅剩三个月即将到期，中方决心以纯中国机构取代临时法院。这将彻底剥夺领事和工部局当局曾经篡夺的残余权力；因此，他们怀着让列强相信终止《收回会审公廨协定》将导致更恶劣状况的希望，对临时法院展开了激烈的攻击运动。

且不说回到外国陪审员实际上成为法庭法官的旧会审公廨时代，让我们指出本协定的缺陷。它非但没有改善局势，反而充满了中国人此前所抱怨的完全相同的缺陷。

该协定最首要的缺点无疑是外国副推事（deputies）的持续存在及其旁听诉讼程序并记录异议的权利。从他们提出的 numerous 愚蠢抗议（《评论周报》专栏不时予以指出）来看，外国副推事显然倾向于重新获得已废止的会审公廨陪审员曾经拥有的权力。副推事们的心胸狭隘、缺乏足够的法律训练以及对华籍法官傲慢的优越感，除了损害中国的尊严外，还使得法院无法顺利运作。

第二个缺陷必须归咎于工部局警务处在控制法院方面所扮演的角色。《收回会审公廨协定》赋予工部局警务处巨大的权力，并将法院房舍以及除民事拘留所和女监以外的所有附属监狱置于其控制之下。法院发出的所有传票、逮捕令和命令也由从工部局警务处抽调的法警执行。曾发生过警察拒绝执行法院命令的情况。凭借《收回会审公廨协定》授予警察的充分权力，法院在很大程度上受制于警察，一旦警察撤回协助与合作，整个机制可能随时停止运转。即使他们屈尊与法院合作，这种合作也从不真诚，且受领事团和工部局的指令支配。

第三，法院外籍首席书记官的任命从未令人满意。根据现行协定，他受托负责法院的财务事务和一般行政工作。他由领事团推荐，其任命被强加给江苏省政府。虽然他受法院的监督和命令约束，但后者无法对他建立有效的控制，未经领事团同意也不能将其免职。他拥有巨大的权力，并得到领事和工部局当局的全力支持。由外国人控制中国机构的财政资源是不正常的——这是中国人必然要消除的局面。

上述几点是《收回会审公廨协定》的一些明显缺陷，需谨记，该协定从未得到国民政府的承认。简而言之，副推事制度的缺陷、工部局警务处对法院的控制、外籍首席书记官一职以及领事团的干涉，严重制约了临时法院的地位，使其几乎不属于中国司法体系的一部分。由于该法院仅对中国公民和无治外法权国家的国民拥有管辖权，它完全有权摆脱外国的影响和干涉。当今的中国当然不能容忍外国干涉其对中国公民行使管辖权。

PROVISIONAL AGREEMENT FOR THE ABOLITION OF THE SHANGHAI MIXED COURT

I. (1) The Kiangsu Provincial Government in place of the Mixed Court
in the International Settlement at Shanghai will establish
the Shanghai Provisional Court. With the exception of cases
which in accordance with the treaties involve the right of
Consular jurisdiction, all civil and criminal cases in the
Settlement shall be dealt with by the said Provisional Court.

(ii) All laws, including laws of procedure, and ordinances
applicable at the present time in other Chinese Courts as well
as those that may be duly enacted and promulgated in the
future shall be applicable in the Provisional Court, due
account being taken of the terms of the present agreement and
of such established rules of procedure of the Mixed Court as
shall be hereafter agreed upon.

(iii) In criminal cases which directly affect the peace and order
of the International Settlement, including contraventions of
the Land Regulations and Bye-laws of the International
Settlement, and in all criminal cases in which the accused
is in the employ of a foreigner having extraterritorial rights,
the Senior Consul may appoint a Deputy to sit with the Judge
to watch the proceedings. The concurrence of the Deputy shall
not be necessary for the validity of the judgment, though he
shall have the right to record his objections; he shall not,
however, put any questions to the witnesses or prisoners
without consent of the Judge.

(iv) All summonses, warrants and orders of the Court shall be
valid after they have been signed by a Judge. All such
summonses, warrants and orders shall be numbered for record
by the Chief Clerk before service. When the summons, warrant
or order is to be executed on premises occupied by a
foreigner having extraterritorial rights, the Consul or other
appropriate official of the power concerned shall on presentation affix his counter-signature without delay.

(v) In cases in which a foreigner having extraterritorial rights
or the Shanghai Municipal Council is the plaintiff in a civil
action and in criminal cases in which a foreigner having
extraterritorial rights is the complainant, the Consul of the
nationality concerned or the Senior Consul may send an
Official to sit jointly with the Judge in accordance with the
provisions of the treaties.

(vi) A Court of Appeal shall be established in connection with the
Provisional Court to deal with criminal cases which directly
affect the peace and order of the Settlement and with mixed
criminal cases. The President of the Provisional Court shall
act concurrently as President of the Court of Appeal. No
appeal shall be allowed in cases in which the penalty is below
the maximum imprisonment of the fifth degree nor in cases
under the Land Regulations and Bye-laws of the International
Settlement.
In all cases in which a Senior Consul's Deputy sat in the
original hearing a different Deputy shall sit in the appeal,
appointed in the same way and having the same rights as the
original Deputy. In the same way a different Consular
Official shall sit in the appeal in mixed criminal cases.

(vii) The President and Judges of the Provisional Court as well as
the Judges of the Court of Appeal shall be appointed by the
Kiangsu Provincial Government.

废除上海会审公廨临时协定

一. (1) 江苏省政府将在上海公共租界设立上海临时法院，以取代会审公廨。除根据条约涉及领事裁判权的案件外，租界内的所有民事和刑事案件均由该临时法院处理。

(ii) 所有法律，包括程序法，以及目前适用于其他中国法院的条例，以及未来正式颁布施行的法律，均适用于临时法院，同时适当考虑本协定的条款以及此后商定的会审公廨既定程序规则。

(iii) 在直接影响公共租界和平秩序的刑事案件中，包括违反《土地章程》和《附律》的行为，以及在被告受雇于享有治外法权的外国人的所有刑事案件中，总领事可指派一名副推事与法官同席旁听诉讼程序。判决的有效性无需副推事的同意，但他有权记录其异议；然而，未经法官同意，他不得向证人或囚犯提出任何问题。

(iv) 法院的所有传票、逮捕令和命令经法官签署后即为有效。所有此类传票、逮捕令和命令在送达前应由首席书记官编号存档。当传票、逮捕令或命令需要在享有治外法权的外国人占用的处所执行时，有关国家的领事或其他适当官员应在出示时立即加签副署。

(v) 在享有治外法权的外国人或上海工部局作为原告的民事案件中，以及在享有治外法权的外国人作为控告人的刑事案件中，有关国籍的领事或总领事可根据条约规定派遣一名官员与法官会同审理。

(vi) 应设立一个隶属于临时法院的上诉法院，以处理直接影响租界和平秩序的刑事案件以及混合刑事案件。临时法院院长应兼任上诉法院院长。刑罚低于第五等最高徒刑的案件，以及依据《土地章程》和《公共租界附律》处理的案件，不得上诉。
在所有初审中有总领事副推事出庭的案件中，上诉时应由另一名以同样方式任命并拥有与原副推事相同权利的副推事出庭。同样，在混合刑事案件的上诉中，应由另一名领事官员出庭。

(vii) 临时法院院长和法官以及上诉法院法官均由江苏省政府任命。

2. In cases involving imprisonment for ten years or more and
in cases involving the death penalty, the Provisional Court
shall report the same to the Kiangsu Provincial Government
for approval. In cases in which the Provincial Government
refuses its approval, the Provincial Government shall give
its reasons and order the Provisional Court to rehear the case
and again submit the judgment to the Provincial Government.
All criminal cases in which the infliction of the death penalty
has been approved shall be remitted to the Chinese Authorities
outside the Settlement for the execution of such penalty.
Inquests and autopsies (Chien Yen) in the Settlement shall be
held jointly by the Judges of the Provisional Court and the
Deputies appointed by the Senior Consul.

3. The prisons attached to the Provisional Court, with the
exception of the House of Detention for civil cases and the
Women's Prison which are to be separately provided for, shall
be under the charge of the Municipal Police specially
detailed for the purpose, but they shall be operated as far
as practicable in conformity with the Chinese Prison Regulations
and subject to the supervision of the Court. The President of
the Provisional Court shall appoint a Visiting Committee, which
shall include a Deputy of the Senior Consul, to make investi-
gations from time to time, and if it is considered that there
are any respects in which the control over the prisoners is
unsatisfactory, the same shall be reported to the Court, where-
upon the Municipal Police shall be charged by the Court to
make the necessary rectification which the said Police shall
carry out without delay.

4. All summonses, warrants and orders issued by the Court shall
be executed by the judicial police who shall be detailed for
this duty by the Municipal Police and be directly responsible
to the Court in the execution of their duties as judicial
police. The Municipal Police shall render full and prompt
assistance in such matters as may be requested of, or entrusted
to them by the Court, and when the Municipal Police arrest any
person, he shall, within twenty-four hours, exclusive of holidays,
be sent to the Court to be dealt with, failing which he shall be
released.

5. In all mixed civil cases where there has been a Consular
Official sitting jointly with the Judge, the appeal shall be
made to the Office of the Commissioner for Foreign Affairs,
acting with the Consul concerned according to the treaties,
but such cases may be turned over to the Provisional Court
for retrial by a different judge, the original Consular
Official being also changed. In the event of a disagreement
between the Commissioner for Foreign Affairs and the Consul in
respect of the appeal in a case which has been retried, the
judgment given at the retrial shall stand.

6. The financial affairs and such administrative work of the
Court as shall be determined by a joint commission shall be
entrusted to a Chief Clerk who shall be recommended by the
Senior Consul and appointed by the Provincial Government on
the receipt of a petition from the Court. He shall be subject
to the supervision and orders of the President of the Court
and shall have charge of the staff and exercise proper
supervision over the Court finances. If the Chief Clerk is
found to be incompetent or remiss in his duty the President
of the Court may reprimand him, and if necessary remove him
from office with the consent of the Senior Consul.

2. 凡涉及判处十年以上监禁及死刑之案件，临时法院须呈报江苏省政府核准。若省政府不予核准，应说明理由，并命令临时法院重审该案，再将判决呈报省政府。凡经核准执行死刑之刑事案件，应移送租界以外之中国当局执行该刑罚。租界内之验尸与解剖（Chien Yen），应由临时法院法官与总领事指派之副领事共同进行。

3. 附设于临时法院之监狱，除民事拘留所及女监另行规定外，应由工部局警务处专门指派人员负责管理，但应在可行范围内尽量依照中国监狱章程运作，并接受法院监督。临时法院院长应任命一个视察委员会，其中包括一名总领事副手，不时进行调查；如认为对囚犯之管束有任何令人不满之处，应向法院报告，随后由法院责令工部局警务处进行必要之整改，该警务处应立即执行。

4. 法院发出之所有传票、逮捕令及命令，应由司法警察执行；该等司法警察由工部局警务处为此目的专门指派，并在履行司法警察职责时直接对法院负责。工部局警务处应就法院要求或委托之事项提供充分且迅速之协助；当工部局警务处逮捕任何人时，该人须在二十四小时内（节假日除外）送交法院处理，否则应予释放。

5. 在所有有领事官员会同法官审理之混合民事案件中，上诉应依据条约向交涉署提出，由交涉署会同相关领事办理；但此类案件可移交临时法院，由另一位法官重审，原任领事官员亦须更换。若在重审案件之上诉问题上，交涉署与领事之间发生分歧，则以重审所作之判决为准。

6. 法院之财务事宜及由联合委员会确定之行政工作，应委托给一名首席书记官负责；该人选由总领事推荐，经法院呈请后由省政府任命。他应受法院院长之监督和指挥，负责管理职员并对法院财务进行适当监管。如发现首席书记官不胜任或玩忽职守，法院院长可予以申斥，并在必要时征得总领事同意后将其免职。

7. The foregoing six articles, forming the Provisional
Agreement for the rendition of the Mixed Court to the
Kiangsu Provincial Government shall be in force for three
years, dating from the day on which the Mixed Court is
handed over. Within this period the Chinese Central
Government may at any time negotiate with the Foreign
Ministers concerned in Peking for a final settlement, which
if agreed upon between the Chinese Central Government and
the said Foreign Ministers, shall replace the present
Provisional Agreement. If at the end of three years no final
settlement has been reached in Peking, the present
Provisional Agreement shall continue to be in force for
another three years. At the end of the first three years,
however, the Kiangsu Provincial Government may propose any
modifications of the present Agreement provided that notice
is given six months before the expiration of the first
period of three years.

8. The present Provisional Agreement shall in no way bind the
Chinese Central Government in any future discussion between
it and the foreign Governments with regard to the abolition
of extraterritoriality.

9. The date on which rendition of the Mixed Court shall take
place under the above Provisional Agreement shall be fixed
by an exchange of notes to take place between the
representative of the Kiangsu Provincial Government and the
Senior Consul.

7. 上述六条构成《关于将混合法庭移交给江苏省政府之临时协定》，自混合法庭移交之日起生效，为期三年。在此期间，中国政府可随时在北京与有关各国公使谈判，以达成最终解决方案；如中国政府与上述公使达成协议，则该协议将取代本临时协定。若三年期满时北京方面仍未达成最终解决方案，则本临时协定继续有效三年。但在第一个三年期满时，江苏省政府可提议对本协定进行修改，惟须在第一个三年期届满前六个月发出通知。

8. 本临时协定绝不约束中国政府在未来与外国政府就废除治外法权问题进行任何讨论时的立场。

9. 根据上述临时协定移交混合法庭之日期，应由江苏省政府代表与总领事通过互换照会确定。

The following draft of Notes for exchange with the Chinese
on the question of the Rendition of the Mixed Court has
been presented to Dr. V. K. Ting who has signified his
approval to the Senior Consul a.i.

It is understood that the Chinese translation of the term
"Court", after rendition, shall be "Fa Yuan" (    ) instead
of "Fa T'ing" (    ).

It is understood that the establishment of the Shanghai
Provisional Court provided for in Article I (i) in no way affects
the validity of the judgments rendered in the past by the Mixed
Court. These judgments are recognised as valid and final in all
cases except in those civil cases in which
(a) the right of Appeal has been reserved and judgment has
remained unexecuted.
(b) judgment has been given in default and has remained
unexecuted.

In both these classes of cases an Appeal or retrial under the
procedure of the Provisional Court shall be allowed.

It is further understood that the Kiangsu Provincial
Government shall place the judgments of the Mixed Court up to the
date of rendition, and the judgments of the Provisional Court from
the date of rendition on exactly the same footing in respect of
validity as the judgments of all other Chinese Courts functioning
within the said province.

It is understood that the competence of the Court as described
in Article I (i) includes also
(a) Mixed Criminal cases arising on foreign vessels within
Harbour limits.
(b) Mixed Criminal cases arising on foreign property including
Municipal roads outside the limits of the Settlement, but
within the districts of Shanghai and Paoshan, provided
always that this understanding shall not operate to preclude
further negotiations regarding the status of such roads.
(c) Mixed Civil cases arising in the surrounding areas within
the districts of Shanghai and Paoshan.

It is further understood that the respective jurisdictions
of the Mixed Courts of the French and International Settlements
remain as defined in the Provisional Agreement of 23th June, 1902.

It is understood that the words "without delay" in the last
sentence of Article I (iv) shall be interpreted as meaning
conformity with the provisions of the treaties

It is understood that the Bye-laws of the International
Settlement mentioned in Article I (iii) and (vi) include all
Bye-laws in force at the date of rendition and that all future
Bye-laws will as a matter of course be communicated to the Chinese
Authorities for the information of the Provisional Court.

With reference to Article I (v) it is understood that in criminal
cases where the citizen of a nation without extraterritorial rights
is an accused and the citizen of a nation with those rights is a
complainant, the case shall be tried in the Provisional Court and a
Consular Official belonging to a third nation shall be asked by the
Court to attend the trial in order to watch the proceedings.

以下关于移交混合法庭问题拟与中方交换之照会草案，已提交给丁文江博士（Dr. V. K. Ting），其已向代理总领事表示认可。

兹理解，“Court”一词在移交后的中文译名应为“法院”，而非“法庭”。

兹理解，第一条第（i）款规定设立上海临时法院，绝不影响混合法庭过去所作判决之效力。除下列民事案件外，这些判决均被承认有效且具有终局性：
(a) 保留上诉权且判决尚未执行者。
(b) 缺席判决且判决尚未执行者。
在这两类案件中，应允许按照临时法院之程序进行上诉或重审。

又兹理解，江苏省政府应将截至移交之日混合法庭之判决，以及自移交之日起临时法院之判决，在效力方面与该省境内其他所有中国法院之判决置于完全同等之地位。

兹理解，第一条第（i）款所述法院之管辖权还包括：
(a) 在港口界限内外籍船只上发生之混合刑事案件。

B. MIXED COURT RULES OF PROCEDURE

We are directed to agree upon such established rules of procedure as should be taken into account in accordance with Article 1 (ii) of the Provisional Agreement.
The present procedure of the Mixed Court is governed in its essentials by the "Rules of Procedure" as embodied in a printed booklet published by the Court, with certain amendments with regard to procedure in respect of security, rent cases and ex parte applications which have never been formally incorporated in the "Rules of Procedure".
We agree that it is advisable to make at the present time only such alterations in the rules and procedure of the Court as are absolutely necessary in consequence of the Rendition Agreement and that any general revision of the rules should be left to a later date when it will have become clearer in what direction adjustment is necessary;

C. DUTIES OF THE CHIEF CLERK

We were required to define what part of the duties in connection
with the Court should be assigned to the Chief Clerk and foreign
members of the staff.
We feel, however, that for us to lay down that they shall have
charge of certain departments and be excluded from others must do
more harm than good.
If the Court is to work successfully on the new lines the most
complete confidence between the Director and the Chief Clerk is
essential. The Chief Clerk will be the servant of the Court and
subordinate in all matters to the Director, and we deprecate any
arrangement which might make it appear, on the one hand, that he is
not to have the full confidence of the Director, or, on the other,
that in certain matters he is independent of the Director or has
loyalties other than those of the Court.
We therefore recommend that it be left for the Director of the
Court to define the actual duties and powers of the Chief Clerk and
foreign members of the staff.

我们要界定与法庭有关的哪些职责应分配给首席书记员和外籍职员。
然而，我们认为，如果我们规定他们负责某些部门而被排除在其他部门之外，弊大于利。
如果法庭要在新体制下成功运作，总监与首席书记员之间建立充分的信任至关重要。首席书记员将是法庭的仆役，在所有事务上均隶属于总监，我们反对任何可能使人产生以下印象的安排：一方面，他得不到总监的充分信任；另一方面，他在某些事务上独立于总监，或拥有除忠于法庭以外的其他效忠对象。
因此，我们建议由法庭总监来界定首席书记员和外籍职员的实际职责和权力。

THE NORTH-CHINA DAILY NEWS, TUESDAY, SEPTEMBER 28, 1926

THE RENDITION OF THE MIXED COURT
Kiangsu Provincial Government to Establish Provincial Court
In International Settlement; New Rules to be Enforced

DETAILS OF PROCEDURE, JUDGES AND LAW

The terms of the provisional agreement for the rendition of the Shanghai Mixed Court were announced yesterday, and will be seen below. The agreement has been signed by all the consular officers of the nations concerned, and is as follows:—

PROVISIONAL AGREEMENT FOR THE
RENDITION OF THE SHANGHAI
MIXED COURT

1.—(I) The Kiangsu Provincial Government in place of the Mixed Court in the International Settlement at Shanghai will establish the Shanghai Provisional Court. With the exception of cases which in accordance with the treaties involve the right of Consular jurisdiction, all civil and criminal cases in the Settlement shall be dealt with by the said Provisional Court.

(II) All laws, including laws of procedure, and ordinances applicable at the present time in other Chinese Courts as well as those that may be duly enacted and promulgated in the future shall be applicable in the Provisional Court, due account being taken of the terms of the present agreement and of such established rules of procedure of the Mixed Court as shall be hereafter agreed upon.

Criminal Cases Affecting Foreigners

(III) In criminal cases which directly affect the peace and order of the International Settlement, including contraventions of the Land Regulations and By-Laws of the International Settlement, and in all criminal cases in which the accused is in the employ of a foreigner having extraterritorial rights, the Senior Consul may appoint a Deputy to sit with the Judge to watch the proceedings. The concurrence of the Deputy shall not be necessary for the validity of the judgment, though he shall have the right to record his objections, he shall not, however, put any questions to the witnesses or prisoners without the consent of the Judge.

(IV) All summonses, warrants and orders of the Court shall be valid after they have been signed by a Judge. All such summonses, warrants and orders shall be numbered for record by the Chief Clerk before service. When the summons, warrant or order is to be executed on premises occupied by a foreigner having extraterritorial rights, the Consul or other appropriate official of the Power concerned shall on presentation affix his counter-signature without delay.

Foreign Civil Cases

(V) In cases in which a foreigner having extraterritorial rights or the Shanghai Municipal Council is the plaintiff in a civil action and in criminal cases in which a foreigner having extraterritorial rights is the complainant, the Consul of the nationality concerned or the Senior Consul may send an official to sit jointly with the Judge in accordance with the provisions of the treaties.

(VI) A Court of Appeal shall be established in connexion with the Provisional Court to deal with criminal cases which directly affect the peace and order of the Settlement and with mixed criminal cases. The President of the Provisional Court shall act concurrently as President of the Court of Appeal. No appeal shall be allowed in cases in which the penalty is below the maximum imprisonment of the fifth degree nor in cases under the Land Regulations and By-Laws of the International Settlement.

In all cases in which a Senior Consul's Deputy sat in the original hearing a different Deputy shall sit in the appeal, appointed in the same way and having the same rights as the original Deputy. In the same way a different Consular official shall sit in the appeal in mixed criminal cases.

Court of Appeal

(VII) The President and Judges of the Provisional Court as well as the Judges of the Court of Appeal shall be appointed by the Kiangsu Provincial Government.

2.—In cases involving imprisonment for ten years or more and in cases involving the death penalty, the Provisional Court shall report the same to the Kiangsu Provincial Government for approval. In cases in which the Provincial Government refuses its approval, the Provincial Government shall give its reasons and order the Provisional Court to rehear the case and again submit the judgment to the Provincial Government. All criminal cases in which the infliction of the death penalty has been approved shall be remitted to the Chinese authorities outside the Settlement for the execution of such penalty. Inquests and autopsies (Chien Yen) in the Settlement shall be held jointly by the Judges of the Provisional Court and the Deputies appointed by the Senior Consul.

会审公廨之收回
江苏省政府将在公共租界设立省法院；新规则将予实施

程序、法官及法律之细则

上海会审公廨收回临时协定之条款于昨日公布，详见下文。该协定已由有关各国领事官员签署，内容如下：—

上海会审公廨收回
临时协定

1.—(一) 江苏省政府将在上海公共租界设立上海临时法院，以取代会审公廨。除根据条约涉及领事裁判权之案件外，租界内所有民事及刑事案件均由该临时法院审理。

(二) 凡目前适用于中国其他法院之所有法律（包括程序法）及条例，以及今后经正当制定和颁布之法律，均适用于临时法院，但须适当考虑本协定之条款，以及此后议定之会审公廨既定程序规则。

涉及外人之刑事案件

(三) 在直接影响公共租界治安之刑事案件中，包括违反《土地章程》及《附律》之案件，以及所有被告受雇于享有治外法权之外人之刑事案件，首席领事可指派一名副手会同法官出庭监审。判决之有效性无需该副手之同意，尽管其有权记录异议，但未经法官许可，不得向证人或囚犯提问。

(四) 法院之所有传票、逮捕令及命令经法官签署后即生效。所有此类传票、逮捕令及命令在送达前，须由首席书记官编号存档。当传票、逮捕令或命令需在享有治外法权之外人所占据之处所执行时，有关国家之领事或其他适当官员应在出示文件后立即加签副署。

涉外民事案件

(五) 在享有治外法权之外人或工部局作为原告之民事案件，以及享有治外法权之外人作为控告人之刑事案件中，有关国籍之领事或首席领事可根据条约规定，派遣官员与法官会同出庭。

(六) 临时法院将设立上诉法院，以审理直接影响租界治安之刑事案件及混合刑事案件。临时法院院长兼任上诉法院院长。刑罚低于第五等最高监禁刑期之案件，以及依据《土地章程》及《附律》审理之案件，不得上诉。

在所有原审中有首席领事副手出庭之案件中，上诉时应由另一名以同样方式任命并享有与原副手同等权利之副手出庭。同样，在混合刑事案件之上诉中，应由另一名领事官员出庭。

上诉法院

(七) 临时法院之院长及法官，以及上诉法院之法官，均由江苏省政府任命。

2.—凡涉及十年或以上监禁之案件及涉及死刑之案件，临时法院应呈报江苏省政府核准。若省政府拒绝核准，应说明理由，并命令临时法院重审该案，再次将判决呈报省政府。所有经核准判处死刑之刑事案件，应移交租界外之中国当局执行死刑。租界内之死因调查及验尸（Chien Yen）应由临时法院法官与首席领事指派之副手共同进行。

CHINESE LAWYERS AND RENDITION
OF THE MIXED COURT

Statement of Attitude of Chinese Bar Association: Right of
Foreign Lawyers to Practice in Chinese Courts:
Chinese Practitioners' Point of View.

CABLED COMPLAINT TO SENATOR BORAH

The Chinese Bar Association and the Federation of College Faculties at Shanghai have issued the following statement on the matter of the rendition of the Mixed Court.

So many of the misleading reports and inaccurate statements in regard to the rendition of the Mixed Court have appeared during the last few days in the local foreign press that we as representatives of the Chinese legal profession, or being otherwise interested in the question, consider it opportune to place before the public what we think about the issue. First of all we deprecate the heat as shown by the foreign legal fraternity in their discussion of the alleged settlement of the principal points between the Chinese officials and the Consular Body concerning the restoration of the Mixed Court to Chinese control. No heated discussion of so important a question would be becoming of persons with a thorough legal training; such involves loss of dignity to the legal profession, with which are always associated impartiality and cool-headedness.

It must be pointed out that the rendition of the Mixed Court to China was decided years ago and cannot be longer deferred without seriously injuring the friendly relationship between China and the Foreign Powers. For 15 years the Chinese have been urging the return of the court, and everybody knows that the failure to effect the rendition constitutes a very real grievance. Fortunately, fair-minded and enlightened foreigners, seeing the reasonableness of the Chinese claim and realizing the necessity of conceding it, have been supporting the negotiations looking forward to the settlement of the question. It is hoped that the negotiations will soon be concluded so that from the whole community, both foreign and Chinese, one cause for friction between them may be removed.

Much Astonishment Caused

Unfortunately the Far Eastern American Bar Association of Shanghai saw fit to issue a statement to the press which has caused much astonishment. The main and only reason for its protest against the rendition of the Mixed Court is too obvious to mention. But the question which confronts us to-day is: are we going to conserve the interests of about 100 foreign lawyers at the expense of justice and at the expense of the friendly relationship between Chinese and foreigners in the whole of China generally and those at Shanghai in particular? America's friendship for China is now put to a test. In the past there has been much manifestation of it, but the fact that the American judicial authorities have allowed the foreign lawyers to use their court room as the meeting place to discuss plans of opposition to the rendition of the Mixed Court which has been under consideration between the Chinese officials and the foreign consular officials including the American Consul-General is rather significant indeed. The use of the American court room with the permission of the Judge for such purposes may easily be construed as an interference of the Judiciary with the functions of the American executive—the American Consul-General in the present case—but that is for the American Senate to say; the Chinese Government should, however, take note of the fact.

Irrelevant Arguments

Some of the cases cited in the statement of the American Bar Association and other statements to show the undesirability of the rendition of the Court at the present moment, it must be pointed out, are irrelevant and the conditions under which the other cases as cited had happened do not exist to-day. If we argue in favour of the restoration of the Mixed Court along the same irrelevant lines, we may mention, to show that "honesty is the best policy" is not always observed among foreign officials, the case of the alleged embezzlement by the U. S. Court Clerk, William A. Chapman and that of Earl B. Rose which were reported in the same issue of the "China Press" in which the foreign lawyers made an attack on the integrity of Chinese officials, etc. There are many such cases that could be cited, but, as we maintain, they are irrelevant.

In regard to the feared restoration of corporal punishment, and the introduction of other abuses, upon the rendition of the Mixed Court, the existing Chinese Code renders this impossible. It would be simple to cite the lynching of negroes in America or the failure to enforce the dry law strictly in that country as proving that the administration of law in America is not without fault. The citing of exceptional cases, however, proves nothing and is unworthy of the lofty and dignified attitude that legally trained men should adopt whether they be Chinese or foreign.

The argument that the presence of foreign lawyers in the Mixed Court would render the court atmosphere wholesome cannot be admitted. Originally the Chinese did not like litigation, but some of the foreign lawyers have hired brokers who were paid on a commission basis to stir up litigation. The Mixed Court has repeatedly ordered that no such broker should be employed in the lawyer's office, but they are still so employed. Any reference to the integrity of these lawyers is, therefore, a disputable point. On the other hand the Chinese Bar in Shanghai and other places maintain a higher standard. For instance they keep no brokers who might be worse than the worst yamen runners, and that does not mean that we defend the yamen runners.

As to the claim of these foreign lawyers that their past practice in the Mixed Court gives them "vested rights," we hold that it is by courtesy and not by right that a foreign lawyer is allowed to practise in a country other than his own. Any government has the inherent right to allow or disallow practice by foreign lawyers. This is one essential attribute of a sovereign government. As to the contention that the rendition of the Mixed Court should await the report of the commission on Extraterritoriality, it shows ignorance of those who have advanced this view, because the rendition of the Mixed Court and the abolition of extraterritoriality should be treated as two separate things.

As to the improvements introduced into the Mixed Court since 1911 as mentioned by the U. S. Bar Association in its statement, they are not so apparent to the Chinese as to the lawyers from the United States. But instead we find in the so-called improvements that there is no appellate court, that the Chinese magistrates are but paid employees of the Consular Body, that the Chinese law is not administered and that the present practice is even against the Yangkingpang regulations both in spirit and letter. The reasons for the Chinese insisting upon the restoration of the Court to its rightful owner are too obvious to need further reference to them in detail. Suffice to say that the rendition of the Court is just, expedient

情报官登记

中国律师与会审公廨的移交

中华律师公会态度声明：外国律师在中国法院的执业权：
中国从业者的观点。

致电博拉参议员的投诉

上海中华律师公会和上海高校教员联合会就会审公廨移交一事发表如下声明。

近日，本地外文报刊上出现了许多关于会审公廨移交的误导性报道和不实陈述。作为中国法律界的代表，或作为对此问题感兴趣的人士，我们认为有必要向公众阐明我们对该问题的看法。首先，我们对外国法律界在讨论所谓中国官员与领事团之间就将会审公廨归还中国管辖的主要要点达成和解时所表现出的激烈情绪表示谴责。对于受过全面法律训练的人来说，对如此重要的问题进行激烈的讨论是不体面的；这会损害法律界的尊严，而公正和冷静始终是法律界所具备的特质。

必须指出，将会审公廨移交给中国是多年前就已决定的事，若再拖延，将严重损害中国与列强之间的友好关系。十五年来，中国人一直敦促收回该法院，众所周知，未能实现移交构成了一个非常真实的怨愤。幸运的是，一些公正且开明的外国人看到了中方诉求的合理性，并认识到让步的必要性，一直支持旨在解决该问题的谈判。希望谈判能早日结束，从而消除中外社区之间的一个摩擦根源。

引起极大震惊

不幸的是，上海远东美国律师协会认为有必要向新闻界发表一份声明，这引起了极大的震惊。其反对移交会审公廨的主要且唯一的原因显而易见，无需赘述。但我们今天面临的问题是：我们要以牺牲正义以及牺牲全中国、特别是上海的中外友好关系为代价，来维护大约100名外国律师的利益吗？美国对中国的友谊正受到考验。过去已有许多表现，但美国司法当局允许外国律师利用其法庭作为集会场所，讨论反对将会审公廨移交的计划，而该移交事宜正在中国官员与包括美国总领事在内的外国领事官员之间审议中，这一事实确实意味深长。经法官许可，为上述目的使用美国法庭，很容易被解读为司法部门对美国行政部门职能的干涉——在本案中即美国总领事——但这应由美国参议院来裁定；然而，中国政府应注意到这一事实。

无关的论点

必须指出，美国律师协会声明及其他声明中引用的一些案例，用以表明目前移交法院是不可取的，这些案例均不相关，且所引用的其他案例发生的条件如今已不存在。如果我们沿着同样不相关的思路论证支持恢复会审公廨，我们可以提及据称美国法院书记员威廉·A·查普曼（William A. Chapman）和厄尔·B·罗斯（Earl B. Rose）的挪用公款案，这些案件刊登在《大陆报》同一期上，而该期报纸中外籍律师攻击了中国官员的廉洁性等。此类案例不胜枚举，但正如我们所坚持的，它们是不相关的。

至于担心在移交会审公廨后恢复肉刑及引入其他弊政，现行的中国法典使这成为不可能。简单地引用美国对黑人的私刑或该国未能严格执行禁酒令，以证明美国的执法并非没有缺陷，是很容易的。然而，引用个别案例证明不了什么，也不符合受过法律训练的人——无论是中国人还是外国人——应采取的高尚和庄重态度。

关于外国律师出现在会审公廨能使法庭氛围健康的论点，是不能接受的。起初，中国人不喜欢诉讼，但一些外国律师雇佣了按佣金制付费的掮客来挑起诉讼。会审公廨曾多次下令，律师事务所不得雇用此类掮客，但他们仍然被雇用。因此，任何对这些律师廉洁性的提及都是有争议的。另一方面，上海及其他地方的中国律师界保持着更高的标准。例如，他们不雇用可能比最差的衙役还糟糕的掮客，这并不意味着我们为衙役辩护。

至于这些外国律师声称他们在会审公廨的过往执业赋予了他们“既得权利”，我们认为，允许外国律师在其本国以外的国家执业是出于礼让而非权利。任何政府都有允许或禁止外国律师执业的固有权利。这是主权政府的基本属性之一。至于主张会审公廨的移交应等待治外法权委员会的报告，这表明提出此观点的人无知，因为会审公廨的移交和废除治外法权应被视为两件独立的事情。

至于美国律师协会在其声明中提到的自1911年以来引入会审公廨的改进，对中国人的影响并不像对美国律师那样明显。相反，我们在所谓的改进中发现，没有上诉法院，中国推事只是领事团的受薪雇员，中国法律没有得到执行，而且目前的实践甚至在精神和条文上都违反了《洋泾浜设官会审章程》。中国人坚持要求将法院归还给其合法所有者的原因显而易见，无需详细赘述。 suffice to say that the rendition of the Court is just, expedient

Alleged Improper Use of

Senator Borah and Senate,

On July 12, American Court

eign lawyers as the meeting
place to discuss plans of
opposition to the restoration

control. This is regarded by
Chinese as an unfriendly act
and interference of the
American judiciary with
diplomatic matters. We desire

Reasons for Opposition

In regard to the practice of law
by foreign lawyers we would re-
solutely oppose them to appear in
the Mixed Court after its rendition
for the following reasons:
1. It is the inherent right of the
Chinese Government to reject or
grant practice by a foreign lawyer
in its courts.
2. Foreigners who do not enjoy
extraterritorial rights are admitted
to practise in any Chinese court, but
those who enjoy the protection of
extraterritoriality are not admitted
by Chinese law to appear before the
Chinese court because if they should
misbehave there is no way to ad-
minister proper discipline to them.
3. Foreigners are not allowed to
practise in the Chinese Court be-
cause they are ignorant of Chinese
customs and the Chinese language.
The use of interpreters involves the
waste of too much valuable time on
the part of the magistrates and
sometimes leads to misinterpreta-
tions.
4. Foreign lawyers employ brokers,
a system that has become a scandal
in Shanghai.

Action produces reaction. We,
therefore, urge in order to preserve
the good relationship between Chi-
nese and foreigners that any discus-
sion calculated to occasion bad feel-
ing and offend susceptibilities on
either side should be avoided; the
better course would be to leave the
matter in the hands of those who

华盛顿特区，博拉参议员及参议院：
7月12日，上海美国法院被外国律师用作集会场所，讨论反对将会审公廨归还中国管辖的计划。中国人认为这是一种不友好的行为，也是美国司法部门对 diplomatic matters 的干涉。我们希望知道参议院是否允许将神圣的美国法庭用于政治目的，并感谢你们在这一微妙问题上的公正态度。
上海高校教员联合会

且符合条约规定。

反对理由

关于外国律师的执业问题，我们将坚决反对他们在会审公廨移交后出庭，理由如下：
1. 中国政府有权拒绝或授予外国律师在其法院执业的权利，这是其固有权利。
2. 不享有治外法权的外国人获准在任何中国法院执业，但享有治外法权保护的人不被中国法律允许在中国法院出庭，因为如果他们行为不端，无法对他们实施适当的纪律处分。

4. 外国律师雇用掮客，这种制度在上海已成为丑闻。
